invariants.rationale: The returned list 'result' is a new ArrayList and should not be null.
Method requires 'clusteringGroup' to call 'getSlices()', so it cannot be null.
All elements added to 'records' via lazyIterator are expected to be non-null HoodieRecord instances.
'clusteringGroup.getSlices()' is used to generate clusteringOps and should not be null.
'result' is a List; size is non-negative.
